title: Turkish course for English speakers, A1 to C1 · Glossa
description: A Turkish course from first words to C1: 76 modules in eight tiers, vowel harmony and the suffixes explained directly, and practice papers for the TYS exam.

card.title: Turkish
card.text: 76 modules from A1 to C1, with vowel harmony, the cases and the suffixes explained step by step.

heading: Learn Turkish with the grammar explained.
lead: A complete course in the standard Turkish of Türkiye, in the spelling of the Turkish Language Association, from the alphabet to C1. Vowel harmony, the cases, the suffix chains and the tenses are taught directly, one step at a time, and every answer gets feedback that says why it was right or wrong.
fineprint: The whole course is free: all 76 modules, the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test. Practice papers, specializations and the other extras are part of Premium, €8.99 a month or €69.99 a year.

panel.label: The course: eight tiers, 76 modules

items.title: Tier 1 · Sounds and first words
items.text: The alphabet, vowel harmony, sen and siz, "to be" as suffixes, var and yok.

items.title: Tier 2 · First sentences
items.text: The locative, dative, ablative and accusative, possessives, the present continuous.

items.title: Tier 3 · The cases and the past
items.text: The past and future tenses, compound nouns, postpositions, can and must.

items.title: Tier 4 · Building fluency
items.text: The imperative, the aorist, the past continuous, comparison, infinitives.

items.title: Tier 5 · Everyday fluency
items.text: The -mIş past, the conditional, relative clauses, converbs, work and education.

items.title: Tier 6 · Intermediate
items.text: The passive and causative, reported speech, noun clauses, the media.

items.title: Tier 7 · Upper intermediate
items.text: Verb government, word formation, formal address, law, business and official Turkish.

items.title: Tier 8 · Advanced
items.text: Modality, word order, style, idioms, spoken Turkish, history and literature.

panel.note: 76 modules in all. A placement test lets you start further up if you already know some Turkish.

sections.heading: What the course teaches, and how

items.title: Grammar taught directly
items.text: Each module explains its grammar before you practise it: why it is evde but parkta, when to use the aorist and when the present continuous, how -dI differs from -mIş. A searchable grammar reference links each rule to the modules that teach it.

items.title: Feedback that says why
items.text: A wrong answer shows the correct one, the reason yours was wrong and a link to the rule. There is no limit on how many exercises you do.

items.title: Every word can be tapped
items.text: Tap any Turkish word, anywhere in the course, for its meanings, its forms, examples and audio, so a long word built from suffixes can be taken apart.

items.title: Common traps, set out
items.text: 13 sets of common traps for English speakers, among them i and dotless ı, no plural after numbers, the question particle, and de/da written joined or apart.

items.title: From everyday to official Turkish
items.text: The later tiers cover the language of work, the media, law, business and offices, and the last tier spoken Turkish, style, idioms, history and literature.

sections.heading: What is free and what is Premium
rows: All 76 modules from A1 to C1, the grammar reference, word practice, the placement test and 13 sets of common traps.
5 questions a day about any exercise or text.
Exercises with audio, and review of the words you learn.

sections.note: Premium is €8.99 a month or €69.99 a year. The Turkish course has no pronunciation feedback or pronunciation practice, as the speech assessment Glossa uses does not cover Turkish.

sections.heading: Practice papers for the TYS
sections.intro: The course has two timed practice papers for the Türkçe Yeterlik Sınavı (TYS), the Yunus Emre Institute's exam of Turkish as a foreign language, used for university study and work in Türkiye.
items: TYS practice papers: what the exam asks, what the papers cover, and where they differ from the real exam.

sections.heading: 13 professional specializations
sections.intro: Each specialization has nine modules in three stages, Foundations, Working vocabulary and Professional, which open as you reach tiers 4, 6 and 8 of the course.

items.question: Is the Turkish course really free?
items.answer: Yes. All 76 modules, the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test are free, with 5 Ask AI questions a day. Premium adds the extras listed above.

items.question: How far does the course go?
items.answer: From first words to C1, in eight tiers. The last tiers cover formal and official Turkish, style, spoken Turkish and literature.

items.question: Which Turkish does it teach?
items.answer: The standard Turkish of Türkiye, spelled by the rules of the Turkish Language Association (Türk Dil Kurumu).

items.question: Can I practise speaking?
items.answer: The Turkish in the course comes with audio, and Premium has conversation practice with an AI character. There is no rating of your pronunciation, because the speech assessment Glossa uses does not cover Turkish.

items.question: Does it prepare me for the TYS?
items.answer: The course teaches Turkish up to C1, and Premium adds two timed practice papers for the TYS. The papers have no speaking test and are shorter than the real exam in reading and listening. The exam page has the details.

closing.heading: Start with the first module.
closing.text: Sign in with Google, take the placement test if you already know some Turkish, and open the first module.
